title: Michael D: v1 feeders in two venue halves - D1 host (Task Scheduler setup, calendar-read, gmail-triage with modify ceiling, tasks-classifier) and D2 GHA (todoist-brief, assemble/render, retention); verification tiers; metering
description: Child D (v1 feeders) of SD-LEO-ORCH-MICHAEL-ROLE-FORMALIZATION-002, in two named venue halves. D1 host half on Windows Task Scheduler: scripts/setup-michael-host-tasks.mjs registering hidden .cmd tasks in the stale-session-sweep-task.cmd shape, scripts/michael/calendar-read.mjs (today plus or minus one on both calendars into michael_calendar_day with day classification), scripts/michael/gmail-triage.mjs (rules-first matching, record-then-act, the MICHAEL_GMAIL_MODIFY_CEILING default 60 marking the run degraded, borderline resurfacing on a newer last_message_id, unmatched threads queued for the seat), and scripts/michael/tasks-classifier.mjs (v1 by chairman decision 42111a33: Drive current-tasks.json through the chairman grant, four-bucket keyword routing, dedupe against Todoist, cleanup-pending.json written back). D2 GHA half, credential-free beyond TODOIST_API_TOKEN: the michael-todoist-brief workflow (retention shipped in child B; brief-assemble, render and finalize are child E per spec section 6), every fifteen minutes inside its ET window with both DST offsets, concurrency cancel-in-progress and timeout-minutes 10. Every feeder is a Node script with exported main(argv, deps), an ET window gate, a per-ET-date dedupe on michael_feeder_runs, PII-safe logging and exit 0 on inert; ordering is enforced by checking upstream run status. Includes the verification tiers (Sonnet remainder, Opus re-judge of needs_you, borderline and a ten percent sample) and metering of model_used, tokens_in and tokens_out. Source of record: docs/michael/02-SPEC.md v0.3 sections 3 and 5.

key_changes.change: lib/michael/feeder.mjs (shared harness): runFeeder({ feeder, venue, window:{start,end}, upstream:[{feeder, accept:[...]}], run(ctx) }, { sb, env, now, logger }) reusing hhmmToMinutes/inWindow from scripts/michael-quiet-tick.mjs and etDateStr; inert outside the window (exit 0); single-flight per (feeder, et_date): a running row younger than 10 minutes makes the fire inert, an existing ok row makes it deduped, attempt = max+1 with one retry on the unique-index conflict; upstream status check against michael_feeder_runs; writes started_at/finished_at/status/counts/log_md (counts and ids only, no prose) and metering columns null for model-free venues; gracefulExit for the Task Scheduler venue; plus lib/michael/rules-match.mjs, one pure matcher over michael_rules.rule_json (domain gmail: from/subject/label/list-id predicates; todoist: role tags; tasks: four-bucket keyword routing)
key_changes.impact: Every feeder shares one window gate, one dedupe, one ordering check and one matcher, so the spec's feeder contract is pinned by one test file, and a */15 host fire cannot collide on UNIQUE (et_date, feeder, attempt)

key_changes.change: Host half on the chairman grant (getAuthenticatedClient from child C, import-time pure, injectable API factories): lib/michael/calendar-client.mjs (events.list today plus or minus one on Primary and the Exelon calendar id from MICHAEL_EXELON_CALENDAR_ID) and scripts/michael/calendar-read.mjs writing michael_calendar_day with coded_marker, optional, overlap_group and the day classification (Recovery/Interpersonal/Shallow/Deep, coded-event override, Tuesday-office rule) in counts; lib/michael/gmail-client.mjs extended with listThreads/getThread/listLabels and scripts/michael/gmail-triage.mjs (labels.list reconciles michael_gmail_labels first, missing label degrades and skips that class; threads.list in:inbox newer_than:1d minus keep-in-inbox labels plus the older sweep; rules-first matching; record-then-act with action_intent then modifyThread then action_taken_at; re-run acts only on intents without action_taken_at; ceiling stop; borderline resurfacing; unmatched queued class null); lib/michael/drive-client.mjs (files.list/get in MICHAEL_TASKS_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID, drive.readonly) and scripts/michael/tasks-classifier.mjs (current-tasks.json, abort if stale over 36h or cleanup-pending.json unconsumed, four-bucket keyword routing via rules-match, dedupe against Todoist 7 days by labels captured plus from-google-tasks, create tasks, stage ambiguous items, write cleanup-pending.json back through the grant only if drive.file write is available else stage it)
key_changes.impact: The three credentialed feeders exist on the only venue allowed to decrypt; Gmail changes are recorded before they happen and bounded by the ceiling

key_changes.change: GHA half: scripts/michael/todoist-brief.mjs in the michael-family shape (export runTodoistBrief({ sb, argv, now, todoist }) plus a private main; createTodoistClient tasks today or overdue excluding EVA, For Processing and the EHG chairman project id from env; role tags from a rules row; Est: line graded deterministically, the rest left ungraded for the seat; michael_todoist_snapshot upsert by (et_date, task_id); overnight mutations only for rows already auto_apply=true with auto_apply_verb in label/reschedule, deduped on (et_date, task_id, action) in mutations_applied) and .github/workflows/michael-todoist-brief-cron.yml (04:45-05:30 ET as two cron lines for EDT and EST, */15, concurrency cancel-in-progress, timeout-minutes 10, npm ci --ignore-scripts, secrets SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, TODOIST_API_TOKEN only) pinned by a wiring test in the michael-retention shape. The spec section 5 ordering rule for the assembler (needs calendar ok, gmail and todoist ok or degraded; proceeds degraded at 05:45 and says so in headsUp) ships as a PURE predicate assembleReadiness({ runs, now }) inside lib/michael/feeder.mjs for child E's brief-assemble.mjs to import; the assemble script and its workflow are child E (VALIDATION c26274e9 condition 2)
key_changes.impact: The GHA venue stays credential-free (0daf3bd8); the assembler's ordering rule is section 5 text pinned here while its only consumer lands in E, with no dangling workflow

key_changes.change: scripts/setup-michael-host-tasks.mjs in the setup-alarm-cron-tasks.mjs shape: MICHAEL_HOST_TASKS table (tasks-classifier, calendar-read, gmail-triage; /SC MINUTE /MO 15 /ST all day, the in-script window makes off-window fires inert), pure buildWrapperScript (CRLF, repo root cd, call node scripts/michael/<feeder>.mjs) writing scripts/cron/michael-<feeder>-task.cmd, hidden launch through scripts/cron/run-hidden.vbs, /RU current user + /NP as in setup-eva-watcher-task.mjs, --dry-run/--status/--verify/--remove; --verify reads the OS XML back; wake-from-sleep is NOT configured (the /XML import path is denied unelevated on this host) and the runbook states the laptop must be awake, a missed window showing as a failed run
key_changes.impact: One command registers the host half; nothing is registered that would open a visible console

key_changes.change: Seat-side verification verbs and metering: scripts/michael/queue-read.mjs (--json list of michael_gmail_triage_items with class null and michael_todoist_snapshot rows without effort_grade for the ET date, bounded) and scripts/michael/classify-record.mjs (writes class/needs_you/needs_you_reason/borderline/verified_by per item and effort_grade/est_minutes/proposed_date per task from a runner-produced JSON file, and upserts the venue=seat feeder_runs row with model_used, tokens_in, tokens_out) plus the tick contract paragraph in docs/protocol/michael/role-contract.md naming the Sonnet remainder, the Opus re-judge of needs_you, borderline and a ten percent sample, and stop-after-read
key_changes.impact: The verification tiers are executable contract text the /michael tick follows on the Max plan, and metering lands in the columns child B declared

key_changes.change: Deletions (LEAD Q8): the retention leg is SUPERSEDED (child B shipped scripts/michael/retention.mjs and michael-retention-cron.yml); brief-assemble.mjs, its workflow, rendering (rendered_html, brief_md), brief-finalize, the API route and the Drive-doc copy are child E (spec section 6 is E's source of record; -D keeps only the pure section 5 ordering predicate); the Adam handoff seam (chairman_handoff origin michael) stays unbuilt until child G; the standing Todoist rule import with its Opus verdict is child F (todoist-brief applies only auto_apply rows that already exist); the Haiku fleet-email summary is seat work named in the contract, not a feeder; no migration in this child (every column used exists in the child B migration; a missing one is routed to child B)
key_changes.impact: Scope is bounded to what the durable venues can do without a model and without a credential in GHA

strategic_objectives: Give Michael the v1 model-free feeders in two venue halves: on the chairman's host (Windows Task Scheduler, the only venue that may decrypt the Google grant) calendar-read, gmail-triage and tasks-classifier; on GitHub Actions (credential-free beyond TODOIST_API_TOKEN) todoist-brief and brief-assemble; every feeder a Node script with exported main(argv, deps), a minute-granular ET window gate, a per-ET-date dedupe on michael_feeder_runs, PII-safe logging and exit 0 on inert, with ordering enforced by reading upstream run status

Make bulk mis-archive impossible in practice: gmail-triage is rules-first and record-then-act, stops applying above MICHAEL_GMAIL_MODIFY_CEILING (default 60) marking the run degraded, resurfaces a previously archived thread with a newer last_message_id as borderline, and queues unmatched threads (class null) for the seat instead of guessing

Keep the model layer at the seat: no feeder calls a model; the verification tiers of spec section 3 land as seat-side verbs (a reader of queued items and a recorder of class, verified_by, model_used, tokens_in and tokens_out into the rows and the feeder_runs summary) so the Max-plan-only rule and the sub-agents-stopped-after-read rule are contract text the tick follows

Make a missed window visible, never silent: a host fire outside its window is inert, a failed API call is a failed run with last_error-style counts, the assembler proceeds degraded at 05:45 and says so in headsUp, and every run row is the gauge source child G reads

Register the host tasks with the sanctioned schtasks path (scripts/setup-alarm-cron-tasks.mjs shape, hidden launcher, verify against the OS-returned XML) and ship the two GHA workflows in the michael-retention-cron.yml shape with both DST offsets, concurrency cancel-in-progress and timeout-minutes 10

success_criteria.measure: lib/michael/feeder.test.js pins each behaviour with an injected client and a fixed now; a grep of scripts/michael/*-read.mjs, gmail-triage.mjs, tasks-classifier.mjs, todoist-brief.mjs, brief-assemble.mjs shows each routed through runFeeder; no thread subject, body, task content or email address appears in any log line (test asserts the log corpus)
success_criteria.criterion: Feeder contract: every feeder exports main(argv, deps), is inert outside its ET window, dedupes per (feeder, et_date), single-flights a still-running fire, checks upstream status, and logs counts and ids only

success_criteria.measure: Unit tests: 80 seeded matched threads with ceiling 60 yield exactly 60 modifyThread calls and status degraded; a killed run re-executed makes no duplicate modify call and completes intents without action_taken_at; an archived thread with a newer last_message_id is written borderline; a thread matching no rule is written with class null and no modify call; a missing label marks degraded and skips that class
success_criteria.criterion: gmail-triage is bounded and reversible: record-then-act, ceiling stop marks degraded, borderline resurfacing, unmatched queued

success_criteria.measure: Both import getAuthenticatedClient; a GITHUB_ACTIONS=true env yields a failed run row with HOST_VENUE_REQUIRED and no API call (unit test); tasks-classifier with a current-tasks.json older than 36h or an unconsumed cleanup-pending.json returns inert/failed without creating tasks
success_criteria.criterion: calendar-read and tasks-classifier run only on the host through the chairman grant and refuse elsewhere

success_criteria.measure: tests/unit/workflows/michael-feeder-workflows.test.js asserts both workflows carry two cron lines (EDT and EST hours for the ET window), concurrency cancel-in-progress, timeout-minutes 10, npm ci --ignore-scripts, only SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (plus TODOIST_API_TOKEN on todoist-brief), no cd in the run step; grep of .github/workflows for MICHAEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY/GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET returns nothing
success_criteria.criterion: GHA half is credential-free beyond TODOIST_API_TOKEN and self-healing in its window

success_criteria.measure: Unit tests on assembleReadiness({ runs, now }): calendar ok plus gmail failed before 05:45 ET yields wait; at or after 05:45 yields proceed with degraded=true and a headsUp naming the missing feeder; all upstream ok yields proceed with degraded=false
success_criteria.criterion: The assembler ordering predicate is pure and pinned for child E

success_criteria.measure: node scripts/setup-michael-host-tasks.mjs --dry-run prints three wrapper files and three schtasks /Create lines with /SC MINUTE /MO 15 and a quoted wscript.exe //B run-hidden.vbs action; tests/unit/fleet/setup-michael-host-tasks.test.js pins the builders and verifyHiddenLaunch; --verify reads XML back (not the submission)
success_criteria.criterion: Host registration is one sanctioned command and verifiable from the OS

success_criteria.measure: queue-read --json lists class-null items and ungraded tasks for the date (bounded, unit test); classify-record from a runner-produced file writes class, verified_by and the seat feeder_runs row with model_used, tokens_in, tokens_out (unit test with injected client; a file without run id and content hash is refused)
success_criteria.criterion: Seat verbs close the queue and write metering
